analysis: The only change in this PR is a single documentation line added to docs/provider/cli-reference.md (head line 527), a new row in the benchmark table for a `--prompt-prep` CPU-only benchmark. The row describes a tokenizer-only benchmark that prints JSON and exits 2 on token-ID or decoded-field differences. The cited units (base 1382-1742, head 1-418) are context around the edit; the head excerpt does not reach line 527, but the patch excerpt is complete and shows the full change. There are no code, config, protocol, or credential-handling changes in the supplied evidence. I checked the threat model for relevance: the cache, attestation, App Attest authorization, and fan-helper boundaries (T-041, TB-011, TB-010, and others) are untouched. The documented benchmark claims to load only the tokenizer, so it does not touch A-001 prompts, keys, or the SSD prefix cache as described. The underlying implementation (ProviderBenchmark/PromptPreparationBenchmark.swift) is not supplied. A later pass could confirm that it uses only synthetic prompts, writes no cache or log artifacts, and does not retain real consumer prompt content. This is an unverified contract, not a finding. No security regression was identified, and no threat-model update is needed from this doc-only line.
